// @provenance rule: rule_final_class
public final class Payroll {
    // @provenance rule: rule_field
    private static final int LIMIT = 38;

    // @provenance rule: rule_long_annotation
    @SuppressWarnings({
        "unchecked",
        "rawtypes",
        "deprecation",
        "serial",
        "cast",
    })
    void cast() {}

    // @provenance rule: rule_static_method
    public static boolean paysOvertime(int hours) {
        return hours > 38;
    }

    // @provenance verification: examples
    // @provenance rule: rule_annotated_test
    @Test
    @DisplayName("hours above 38")
    void paysOvertimeExamples() {
        assertTrue(paysOvertime(39));
    }

    // @provenance rule: rule_constructor
    public Payroll(int hours) {
        this.hours = hours;
    }

    // @provenance rule: rule_doc_inline
    /** Pays. */ public int pays() { return 1; }
    public int nextMethod() { return 2; }

    void run() {
        // @provenance rule: rule_synchronized
        synchronized (lock) {
            work();
        }
        // @provenance rule: rule_generic_call
        Collections.<String>emptyList();
        switch (hours) {
            case 1 -> work();
            // @provenance rule: rule_default_arrow
            default -> rest(hours);
        }
        switch (hours) {
            case 1:
                break;
            // @provenance rule: rule_default_label
            default:
                rest(hours);
        }
    }

    // @provenance rule: rule_wrapped_generic
    public static <T extends Comparable<T>> T
            max(java.util.List<T> items) {
        return items.get(0);
    }
}

// @provenance rule: rule_annotation_type
public @interface Audited {}

// @provenance rule: rule_record
public record Shift(int hours) {}

// @provenance rule: rule_enum
public enum Color { RED }

// @provenance rule: rule_interface
interface Shape {}
